source_policy: CAP/ASCO biomarker guidelines, FDA companion-diagnostic labels, primary trial literature. Internal research substrate only; articles cite primary sources directly.

biomarker_records.specimen: FFPE; cold ischemia <1 h, fixation 6–72 h in 10% NBF
biomarker_records.scoring: Percentage of tumor nuclei staining at any intensity; ASCO/CAP reports positive at >=1%, with a 1–10% 'ER-low positive' category flagged as a distinct biologic group.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Positivity gates endocrine therapy (SERMs, aromatase inhibitors, SERDs) and, with other factors, CDK4/6 inhibitors.
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: ASCO/CAP ER/PgR guideline (Allison et al. 2020 update)

biomarker_records.specimen: FFPE; same preanalytic constraints as ER
biomarker_records.scoring: Percentage of tumor nuclei staining; positive at >=1%.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Supports endocrine sensitivity prediction alongside ER; ER+/PR- tumors carry a less favorable endocrine-response profile.

biomarker_records.specimen: FFPE; cold ischemia <1 h, fixation 6–72 h
biomarker_records.scoring: IHC 0 / 1+ / 2+ / 3+ per ASCO/CAP membrane-staining criteria; IHC 2+ is equivocal and reflexed to ISH. ISH interpreted by HER2/CEP17 ratio and average HER2 copy number across the five-group algorithm.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: HER2-positive (IHC 3+ or ISH-amplified) gates anti-HER2 therapy (trastuzumab/pertuzumab, T-DM1, tucatinib regimens). Separately, IHC 1+ or 2+/ISH-negative ('HER2-low') gates trastuzumab deruxtecan in the metastatic setting per DESTINY-Breast04, though ASCO/CAP/NCCN do not endorse 'HER2-low' as a formal interpretive category.
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: ASCO/CAP HER2 guideline (Wolff et al. 2018, reaffirmed 2023); FDA T-DXd label expansion; DESTINY-Breast04 (Modi et al. NEJM 2022)

biomarker_records.scoring: Percentage of tumor nuclei positive; standardization remains a recognized limitation (International Ki-67 Working Group guidance).
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Contributes to risk stratification; a high index is one input among several (used in some adjuvant decision contexts, e.g., abemaciclib eligibility frameworks that incorporated Ki-67).
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: International Ki-67 in Breast Cancer Working Group recommendations

biomarker_records.scoring: Continuous recurrence score 0–100; interpreted with age and nodal status.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Informs whether to add adjuvant chemotherapy to endocrine therapy in HR+/HER2- early disease; validated prospectively in TAILORx (node-negative) and RxPONDER (1–3 nodes).
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: TAILORx (Sparano et al. NEJM 2018); RxPONDER (Kalinsky et al. NEJM 2021)

biomarker_records.scoring: Binary low- vs high-risk genomic classification.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Identifies clinically high-risk HR+/HER2- patients who may safely forgo chemotherapy; validated in MINDACT.

biomarker_records.scoring: Pathogenic / likely pathogenic variant vs none.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Pathogenic gBRCA gates PARP inhibitors (olaparib adjuvant per OlympiA; olaparib/talazoparib in metastatic per OlympiAD/EMBRACA) and informs risk-reducing surgery.
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: OlympiA (Tutt et al. NEJM 2021); OlympiAD; EMBRACA; FDA PARP-inhibitor labels

biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Mutation gates alpelisib (PI3K inhibitor) plus fulvestrant in HR+/HER2- advanced disease.
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: SOLAR-1 (André et al. NEJM 2019); FDA alpelisib label / companion dx

biomarker_records.scoring: Combined Positive Score (CPS) on the 22C3 assay for TNBC; antibody- and platform-specific cutoffs.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Positivity gates pembrolizumab in PD-L1+ metastatic TNBC (KEYNOTE-355).
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: KEYNOTE-355 (Cortes et al.); FDA pembrolizumab companion dx (22C3, CPS >=10)

biomarker_records.scoring: MMR protein loss; MSI-high; tumor mutational burden >=10 mut/Mb.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab indication for MSI-H/dMMR or TMB-high solid tumors, relevant to rare breast cases.
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: FDA tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab approvals (KEYNOTE-158 and related)

biomarker_records.scoring: Fusion present vs absent; pan-TRK IHC as screen with molecular confirmation.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Fusion gates TRK inhibitors (larotrectinib, entrectinib); enriched in secretory carcinoma (ETV6::NTRK3).

biomarker_records.scoring: Activating ESR1 ligand-binding-domain mutation present vs absent.
biomarker_records.therapy_linkage: Acquired ESR1 mutation gates elacestrant (oral SERD) in ER+/HER2- advanced disease after prior endocrine therapy.
biomarker_records.companion_dx_basis: EMERALD (Bidard et al.); FDA elacestrant label / companion dx

notes: ER-low (1–10%), the HER2-low/ultralow debate, and ctDNA-based ESR1 testing are the most actively moving areas — re-verify cutoffs and indications at writing time. 'HER2-low' is a therapy-relevant category (T-DXd) that is NOT a formal ASCO/CAP interpretive tier; articles must state both facts to be accurate.
